column1: # The blocking gate's selections (dev/block.jl, `bash dev/gate.sh --block`; L194), measured by
# test/block_impact.jl from the lines of src/ each probe, each smoke group and each QA family a lock
# cites as behavior runs, cut into 40-line pieces of each top-level definition (225 probes run 955
# pieces of src/, 21 cover them; 104 smoke groups run 1196, the core's 12 groups (84 cases, 29.2 s
# recorded) run 1062; the 17 cited QA families run 1193). `probes`: the probe core, a cover of every
# piece any probe runs; the gate adds the probes a change touches in test/probe_corpus.jl or
# test/probe_baseline.txt. `core`: the smoke core every landing runs, the cover by pieces per
# recorded second (test/smoke_times.tsv) up to 30 s; the first group pays for compiling the
# compiler. `<file><TAB><groups><TAB><QA families><TAB><1.13 groups>`: a changed file's groups
# beyond the core, the cover (up to 25 s) of its pieces some group runs and the core does not, then
# the QA families the gate's tests stage runs for it, the cover (up to 20 s of
# test/phase_times.tsv's seconds) of its pieces run by the QA families its locks cite as behavior
# (the locks reading it by path; a family past 20 s on its own runs on the full matrix only), then
# the smoke groups the gate runs on Julia 1.13 when the file changes (set by hand for a file whose
# output prints Julia's own signatures or types, which differ between versions: the export namer,
# trimcollect.jl's show_spec_sig); `-` for none (a directory row, ending in /, covers its files; the
# longest match wins). A changed file under src/ or ext/, or a changed test file no stage runs and
# no QA family is, with no row fails the gate: a batch that adds a file adds its row, re-recorded
# or, when unsure, naming more. `matrix-only`: groups no stage here runs, even when the change
# touches them or a row names them: test/registry_cases.jl's generated groups (712 cases, ~300 s a
# version on CI), whose blocking sample is its registry_sample group (Amendment 117-14: split, never
# exempt), and entered_paths, which exists for a matrix-only check (the emission-diff check's Base
# paths, L190). Every probe, group and QA family still runs on every landed head (non-blocking:
# gate.yml on march/**). `measured`: the src tree measured (the gate notes how many pieces of src
# changed since); re-record when src/ or the corpora move on.
